messages:
maria (sales): Heads-up: Globex POC is blocked. Their ingestion pipeline fails when the model is invoked with function calls + json_mode. They need help ASAP, trial ends Friday.
globex-dan (customer): repro snippet attached. sometimes the function payload is valid JSON, sometimes it arrives with a short human sentence appended. we parse with a strict schema so it errors. raw output: ```{"records": [{"uid": "a1", "score": 0.93}]}
Note: keeping context minimal to reduce tokens.```
devin (solutions): can you share the request id(s) and the SDK call you're using? are you using streaming or non-streaming?
globex-dan (customer): request=gid_77ab, using streaming via SDK v1.3. call: `client.generate({model: 'open-r-1', json_mode: true, functions: [..], stream: true})`
lee (eng-runtime): streaming + json_mode known corner case: sometimes the model emits a trailing commentary token after the closing brace, especially when generation is cut off by a token limit or rate-limited. that trailing sentence is user-visible in the stream.
ops-bot: Notice: rate-limit spike detected at 2024-07-05T12:15:03Z for org globex qps=40 limit=35.
globex-dan (customer): yes saw some 429s in our logs. here's snippet:
```
2024-07-05T12:15:03Z WARN request gid_77ab 429 TooManyRequests qps=40 limit=35
2024-07-05T12:15:04Z INFO stream-partial gid_77ab "{\"records\": [{\"uid\": \"a1\", \"score\": 0.93}]} Some summary"
```
maria (sales): is this purely a runtime bug or do we recommend capacity/pricing changes?
devin (solutions): two parallel tracks: 1) runtime tweaks to avoid trailing commentary 2) offer a short-term QPS increase for the POC to avoid 429s. pricing: sales-ops can provide a time-limited bump.
lee (eng-runtime): immediate runtime options: - require `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict` header to auto-fail responses with non-JSON suffix - enable `stream_sanitizer=truncate_nonjson` on the route to cut trailing text - increase `token_budget` so model finishes response instead of adding explanatory text - server-side post-parse check that response matches schema before returning to client
nora (security): Globex has regulatory requirements: logs must be retained 365 days and request payloads can't be stored unencrypted. if we do a dedicated bump we need to confirm log redaction and KMS scope.
maria (sales): putting legal and sales-ops on copy. Globex flagged retention as a contract blocker.
globex-dan (customer): after enabling strict header and truncate_nonjson locally, parse success rate improved to ~98%, still seeing rare truncated last object when we hit 429. sending new ID gid_77ac.
lee (eng-runtime): send gid_77ac logs. if it's truncated we'll add `atomic_response=true` for that route (buffer until complete JSON or timeout) and return 502/partial only if timeout. also suggest client-side: if parse fails and http status 200, attempt a single retry with `prefer_json=true` header.
devin (solutions): I'll draft a one-page runbook: headers to set, small retry snippet, and recommended pricing for a 2-week QPS bump vs Dedicated trial.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #POC-604 for temporary QPS increase request.
maria (sales): thanks everyone. Globex, we'll follow up with pricing and legal on retention. please keep sending any failing raw outputs. :pray:
globex-dan (customer): thanks, doing a 1k-record run now and will report back in 20m.
